## Requirements: Public verified engineering lineage and parent #1782 Acceptance closure

**Parent:** #1782 (closed 13/13 on 2026-10-22; the parent-closure half of this issue is complete). **Prerequisites:** #1904 exact-HEAD review observation, #1664 canonical Issue/Slice/Agent/Run identity and trusted Acceptance sources, #1692 canonical sanitized traces, #1737 deterministic report, #1702/#1728 exact-SHA E2E/SC verdicts. **#1690 is required only for stronger orphan integrity claims**, not for metadata-only public lineage.

**Problem:** Pages currently shows canonical GitHub Issue Timeline `cross-referenced` PR edges, PR HEAD CI/E2E run metadata and aggregate Agent 7d/30d usage, but these are independent observations. None proves a causal **implementing** Issue → PR → logical Agent/Slice → provider run/attempt → exact-SHA Review/E2E/SC Acceptance chain. A join merely sharing an Issue number or workflow name must never be promoted to verified provenance.

### Design / delivery

1. Establish a versioned, **public-safe read-only identity projection** sourced from pinned canonical GitHub Issues/PRs/Actions, Metrics `raw/workflows` / sanitized traces and trusted Acceptance evidence. Never publish raw or arbitrary orphan bytes. Validate authoritative repository, Issue, PR, commit SHA, workflow Run ID/attempt, role/agent ID and Slice/task linkage **only when producer records explicitly attest the binding**. A source record missing `agent.id`, role, target SHA, implementing PR or verified source identity remains **Unknown / Unlinked**; do not invent a join.
2. Consume independent per-PR review event observation from #1904 and exact-HEAD CI/E2E from #1834. For SC result, consult only trusted canonical Case/Agent Acceptance results at the applicable SHA and criterion; never infer from Issue checkbox, comment, workflow title, stale HEAD or GitHub Timeline mention. Maintain event timing/attempt identity and identity collisions fail closed.
3. Bound and deterministically sort source windows, pagination, joins, duplicate attempts, evidence counts, public payload size and display count; emit source ref SHA, generated time, coverage and source availability. When producer cannot attest identity, present partial graph with literal Unknown/Unlinked and source backlinks; no invented successes.
4. Independent `pages/` Collaboration drilldown and Evidence view add progressive Issue/PR/Agent/Run/Review/CI/E2E/Acceptance detail (only when independently observed) with canonical provenance links. No product `web/` design/components, runtime tokens, private hosts or live privileged endpoints.
5. Harden parent-specific Case fixtures: exact SHA/rerun/attempt drift, mixed schema and partial source failure, pagination/truncation, ambiguous duplicate parent, cross-repo spoofing, malicious Issue text, unsafe URL/paths/token markers, unavailable-vs-observed-zero. Selected browser regressions `pages-overview` and `pages-evidence` verify deep links, source links and truthful missing evidence. Parent #1782's own 13-SC acceptance is complete and was not copied from children; this issue does not reopen it.
6. Public orphan inventory may show existing store names and ref states; never display verified write auth/immutability/audit until #1690 produces independent anchored proof.

**Source-readiness gate:** Before emitting any `verified` causal edge, supply a positive real canonical record (not a fixture) proving the entire upstream identity chain. If #1664 does not yet emit required source identifiers, keep this issue Open and request the missing field from #1664's owner rather than adding a competing Pages telemetry writer or fabricating a derivation.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 Exact-provenance, bounded, versioned public join contract consumes **only authenticated producer-backed** Issue/PR/Agent/Slice/Run-attempt/SHA identities and records per-edge verification/coverage.
- [x] SC-02 Missing/ambiguous/stale/cross-repo/unverified connections and SC verdicts fail closed to Unknown/Unlinked; no shared-Issue heuristic, aggregate inference or orphan integrity overclaim.
- [x] SC-03 Standalone Pages UI offers source-backed progressive drilldown with canonical safe links, source freshness, exact HEAD/attempt/SC view and truthful partial failures.
- [x] SC-04 Deterministic security/data fixtures and selected browser E2E prove dedupe/order, exact-SHA, pagination, version drift, partial failures, unsafe content and non-coupling with `web/`.
- [ ] SC-05 Exact PR-head Quality, Pages CI, Case Smoke, E2E and canonical Agent Acceptance pass for the lineage implementation, without copying or promoting any parent-scope SC.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-04:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-05:
    when: merged
    branch: main
    method: agent
```
